# chunkfmt golden fixtures

Generated by the originating project's own code at commit `15ea0c51` with `golden-generator/` (see its README for the exact commands). Do not edit by hand; regenerate.

| path | content |
|---|---|
| `plain/*.bin` | the inputs (zeros, text, incompressible noise, empty, one byte) |
| `objects/<name>.{raw,zstd3,zstd19}.cch1` | the originating `encode_object` output for each input and setting |
| `hashes.json` | `ChunkHash::of` and `ChunkHash::keyed([7;32])` of each input |
| `slices.json` | `ChunkLayout::slices`, `chunk_count`, `chunk_len` for several layouts and ranges |
| `e2e/keyring.json` | a `KeyringBlock` created by `create_keyring_block` (passphrase in `passphrase.txt`) |
| `e2e/kdf_domain.bin`, `e2e/pin_context.txt` | the key-derivation labels the keyring was used under (compiled into the test's `KeyDomain`) |
| `e2e/derived.json` | the addressing key, gossip secret, DEKs (`p0`, empty, `mtree/nodes`, a 300-byte name), pin fingerprint and keyed hash derived from that keyring |
| `e2e/sealed_text.bin` | `encrypt_object(dek("p0"), chunk_hash, encode_object(text, zstd:3))` |

## Origin -> replicix (`tests/golden.rs`)

`cargo test -p replicix-chunkfmt --test golden`: every object decodes to its input and re-encodes byte for byte; hashes, slices and derived keys are equal; the sealed object opens.

## replicix -> origin

`cargo run -p replicix-chunkfmt --example golden_out -- <outdir>` writes this crate's objects, a fresh keyring, its derived keys and a sealed chunk (the sibling examples of `replicix-objcas` and `replicix-csi-common` write theirs under the same `<outdir>`, in `objcas/` and `csi-common/`). `golden-gen verify <outdir>` (golden-generator) checks all of it with the originating code: the encodings are byte-equal to its own, and its `unlock`/`decrypt_object` open ours.
